description: Send the user's reply to a message from Moneda that asks for one. The reply is delivered to the Moneda team, so only send text the user wrote or explicitly approved word for word, never text you composed on your own, and show it to the user before sending. One reply per message (max 600 characters); it cannot be edited afterwards, only undone within 10 seconds (undo_message_reply). When the message takes a document, first stage it with request_message_reply_upload and pass the `uploadKey` plus the file's display name.

body.description: Reply text, written or approved by the user.

fileName.description: Display name of the attached document, e.g. 'payslip.pdf'.

uploadKey.description: From request_message_reply_upload, after the curl PUT succeeded.

name: reply_to_moneda_message
